idea-plugin.name: Penguin XAML
idea-plugin.description:
A drag-and-drop XAML designer for Avalonia apps on Linux, in the spirit of the classic WPF designer.

  • Open a .axaml window to see it drawn above its XAML, kept in step both ways.
  • Drag controls in from the Toolbox; see which panel and which Grid row and column they will land in.
  • Select, move, resize and delete on the canvas; each change is one undo step.
  • Edit properties, add and resize Grid rows and columns, and double-click a button to write its Click handler.
  • Only the lines that change are touched, so your XAML formatting is kept.

Needs the .NET 10 runtime. Works offline; the plugin makes no network requests.
